title: BridgeCast: Bridging Ocean Wave Forecasts to Reanalysis via Flow Matching with Exogenous Variables
abstract: arXiv:2610.03759v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Ocean wave forecasting is essential for maritime safety, offshore operations, and coastal resilience, yet remains challenging due to systematic biases in physics-based models. Physical models, while widely used, rely on approximations and parameterizations that limit their accuracy under complex ocean-atmosphere conditions. To enhance ocean wave forecasting, we propose BridgeCast, within a physics-AI hybrid framework for bias correction. BridgeCast is a probabilistic model based on conditional flow matching (CFM) that learns to transform physical model forecasts into reanalysis-like fields. It treats physical forecasts as corrupted observations and employs a continuous-time generative process to bridge their distribution toward that of reanalysis data. translated_title: BridgeCast：借助引入外生变量的流匹配，将海浪数值预报桥接至再分析数据
translated_abstract: 海浪预报对海上安全、海上作业以及沿海抗灾能力至关重要，但由于基于物理的模型存在系统性偏差，其预报仍然充满挑战。物理模型虽然被广泛使用，但依赖近似和参数化方法，这在复杂的海气条件下限制了其精度。为了提升海浪预报水平，我们提出了 BridgeCast——一个物理-AI 混合框架下的偏差校正方法。BridgeCast 是一个基于条件流匹配的概率模型，它学习将物理模型预报转换为类似再分析的场。该方法将物理预报视为受污染的观测，并采用连续时间生成过程，将其分布桥接至再分析数据的分布。BridgeCast 采用基于 Transformer 的架构进行参数化，支持时空建模、引入外生大气变量，并可借助此实现灵活的推断。
tldr: BridgeCast 提出了一种基于条件流匹配与 Transformer 架构的物理-AI 混合概率模型，能够将物理模式的海浪预报偏差校正为再分析级别的场，并可融合外生大气变量实现灵活的时空推断。
en_tdlr: BridgeCast is a physics-AI hybrid probabilistic model based on conditional flow matching and a Transformer architecture that bias-corrects physical ocean wave forecasts into reanalysis-like fields while incorporating exogenous atmospheric variables for flexible spatiotemporal inference.
